pages.text: $(thing)Tolerance$()$(br2)The body must also know not to attack itself: regulatory cells that call off the response. Reality has them too, and a breach is read as self. Law Wraiths leave you be.

$(thing)Insight$(): 160$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Adaptive Immunity.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Antibody, 1 Crystallised Law.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Effector cells of number E are held down by regulatory cells R, each damping by g. Write the net drive D they have left.
